Definition: probably strengthened from the base of G2476; properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e. (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with):--avoid, withdraw self.
BiblicalUsage: The word is withdrawing, setting oneself apart. Paul says he is avoiding this, that no man should blame us in the abundance administered by us, and he commands the brethren to withdraw themselves from every brother that walketh disorderly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the withdrawal is care, not pride: care for the offering's name, and care for the church's order.
